title: Not exactly what we expected...
text: Not exactly what we expected.... Not very substantial - had hoped it would work as an office rug, but it wouldn’t  stand up for much use.  More of a mat than a rug.  It works well as a mat for an SUV - for pets in the back.  Also good for camping for tent floor since it has a backing that is okay.  Maybe good for a  child’s room with wood floor - non-skid back would be good.  Just disappointed that it wasn’t appropriate for our small home office.
